units: metres, except training_chamfer_m2 and training_chamfer_sum_m2 in square metres

definitions.directional: Unsigned nearest-triangle distance from every source mesh vertex to the full opposite mesh; RMS, numpy linear p95, maximum.
definitions.symmetric_p95: max(p95(white_to_scan), p95(scan_to_white)); not a pooled percentile
definitions.aggregate: Frame 0 excluded; RMS gives equal weight to each remaining frame and to each direction, regardless of vertex counts.
definitions.frozen_frame0: The embedded white surface at trajectory frame 0 is held fixed in world coordinates against every recorded frame.
definitions.training_chamfer: When samples exist: 0.5*mean nearest-vertex squared distance each direction, using target_vertex_indices[0] and target_points[frame], as in fast training. Sum excludes frame 0.

scope: No rigid registration, per-frame alignment, simulation or geometry modification. CPU Warp mesh queries use float32 geometry; embeddings and metric reductions use float64. Vertex sampling is not surface-area weighting, signed penetration or a continuous Hausdorff distance. No collision or tetrahedron-inversion pass can be inferred from these metrics. Frozen baseline includes initial placement error.

rollout_provenance.scope: Measurements use the saved real forward rollout identified by its report, not a new simulation run. Subsequent edits changed adjoint guards, startup/progress/restart UI, and descriptions; the saved solver and data fingerprints remain in the linked report.

geometry_extrema.definition: Highest Z-coordinate of the complete surface at each frame, not tracked material displacement. Drop is relative to each surface at frame18. No alignment.

experiment_inputs.probe_motion: Hand-authored reference UR5 FK trajectory, not measured probe poses.
experiment_inputs.time: 30Hz frame spacing is assumed; no timestamps in local recording.
experiment_inputs.white_blue_display_transform: Same display-only Z translation; comparison uses unchanged recording coordinates.

interpretation: Recorded deformation is not reproduced: surface RMS improves only 0.034% over a completely frozen white cube. No physics acceptance is asserted; signed penetration is measured in the separate linked rollout report.

checks.ruff: check and format passed for 89 files

local_private_figure.scope: Local research figure; includes private scanned surface and is kept under ignored nsys/results.
